items.html: Afterward, phase three, which is the Vav that includes the expansion of the Mochin as above, and in this phase ZA is called the Vav of HaVaYaH, and understand this. And this Vav, which is phase three, is called Daat. And here the three letters Yod-Heh-Vav of HaVaYaH, which include the expansion of the Mochin as above, are completed. And it is known that Yod-Heh-Vav are Habad [Hochma, Bina, Daat], and understand this.
